basics.name: Anass Benomar
basics.title: Full Stack Developer
basics.summary: Full Stack Developer with experience in building, optimizing, and maintaining enterprise-grade applications. Experienced in building robust business features using Spring Boot, Angular, SQL, and Representational State Transfer (REST) APIs, as well as conducting deep-dive incident investigations, performing Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and collaborating across cross-functional development and operations teams to ensure high application availability.

work.position: Full Stack Developer and DevOps Engineer

projects.name: Transport Hub – Vehicle Management App
projects.description: Enterprise fleet and transport management platform
highlights: Developed enterprise fleet management features using Spring Boot, Angular, and PrimeNG, enabling scheduled reporting emails, user reservation action tracking, and real-time vehicle availability management.
Resolved frontend and backend issues across the application stack, improving reliability and user experience.

projects.name: TIM AM – TIM BUSINESS
projects.description: Production support and DevOps activities for enterprise applications
highlights: Ensured production stability by monitoring applications, analyzing incidents with Kibana and logs, and collaborating with teams to resolve service issues.
Maintained cloud-based applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), troubleshooting containerized services and supporting high availability.
Improved operational reliability through infrastructure maintenance, Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) certificate renewals, cache optimization, and system improvements.
Supported reliable backend microservice releases through Jenkins Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
Delivered Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) application and content updates using CRX Package Manager.

projects.name: Kafaa'at – Employee Management App
projects.description: Internal employee and project management platform
highlights: Developed employee management, project tracking, and resource pool modules using Spring Boot, Angular, and PrimeNG.
Built responsive user interfaces and improved business workflows through full-stack development.
Enhanced backend test coverage to over 80% by implementing JUnit and Mockito unit tests, leveraging AI-assisted development to improve test creation efficiency and maintain code quality.
